decks.notes: This Grixis Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying threats like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It uses cards like Brainstorm, Daze, and Force of Will to protect its creatures and keep opponents off balance. Lightning Bolt provides additional removal while Mishra's Bauble and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student offer card advantage. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Brazen Borrower and Wasteland to control the board. The key strategy is to maintain a fast and aggressive tempo while disrupting the opponent's plans.

This UWx Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption while also establishing card advantage through powerful planeswalkers like Narset, Parter of Veils. The deck also includes powerful threats like Murktide Regent to close out the game quickly once the opponent's resources are depleted. The mana base is designed to support a variety of colored spells and ensure consistency in casting the deck's powerful spells. The deck aims to control the game's pace and win with a combination of disruption and powerful threats.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the Painter's Servant and Grindstone combo as quickly as possible to mill the opponent's library in one turn. The deck includes cards like Goblin Welder and Goblin Engineer to help find and recur combo pieces, along with disruption in the form of Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast. This deck is all about setting up a quick win condition and disrupting the opponent's game plan to secure victory in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard, using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. By utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Thoughtseize to set up the graveyard and disrupt opponents, combined with counter magic like Force of Will and Daze for protection, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Brazen Borrower to control the board and maintain tempo.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor combo to mill the deck, while simultaneously creating infinite triggers with Narcomoeba to win the game. By efficiently manipulating the graveyard and library, the deck aims to set up Thassa's Oracle as its win condition. The deck also includes disruption spells like Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares to protect the combo, as well as card draw and manipulation cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary pieces. Additionally, the deck leverages cards like Urza's Saga and Teferi, Time Raveler to further enhance its game plan.

The main focus of this Eldrazi Aggro deck is to quickly deploy powerful Eldrazi creatures onto the battlefield while disrupting the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Chalice of the Void to lock down opponent's spells, Thought-Knot Seer to strip away key cards from their hand, and It That Heralds the End to deliver a devastating blow, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its aggressive threats. The deck also features mana acceleration through cards like Lotus Petal and Ancient Tomb to allow for explosive plays early in the game.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent with a mix of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and counterspells like Force of Will, while also controlling the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Sheoldred's Edict. The deck also utilizes card advantage engines like Narset, Parter of Veils and Lórien Revealed to keep the opponent in check. With a versatile suite of threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent to secure victory in the late game.

The key strategy of this Merfolk aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of powerful Merfolk lords such as Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident, along with disruptive elements like Harbinger of the Seas and True-Name Nemesis. The deck aims to establish an early board presence and control the game with counterspells like Force of Will and disruptive spells like Sink into Stupor. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for efficient creature deployment, while lands like Wasteland provide additional disruption. The deck focuses on aggressive creature-based strategies within the Legacy format.

The deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using Cloudpost and Tron lands to play powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul and Ulamog. It also utilizes various control elements like Disruptor Flute and Karn, the Great Creator to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck can quickly overwhelm opponents with its large threats and land destruction capabilities, making it difficult for them to mount a defense. The inclusion of cards like Bojuka Bog and Glimmerpost for utility and lifegain adds to the overall strategy of outlasting opponents while maintaining board presence.

This deck aims to quickly ramp up mana using fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to cast disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Blood Moon early in the game. It then utilizes aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with removal spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption. The deck also includes powerful finishers like The One Ring and Shatterskull Smashing to secure victory. Overall, the strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while presenting a fast and aggressive clock to win the game.

The main idea of this deck is to use aggressive and disruptive dragons in combination with powerful artifacts to quickly overwhelm and lock down opponents. By using accelerants like Simian Spirit Guide and Chrome Mox, the deck can quickly play out threats like Karn, the Great Creator and Blood Moon to disrupt opponent's strategies. Ensnaring Bridge and Chalice of the Void help control the board while cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sundering Eruption provide direct damage to finish off opponents. The deck aims to win fast and decisively through a combination of fast aggression and disruptive elements.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively play creatures and spells with high mana efficiency and utilize cards like Chalice of the Void to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to have a fast start and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while controlling the board with disruption spells. The inclusion of cards like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provides card advantage and further adds to the deck's overall aggression and tempo. The mana base is designed to support the deck's fast pace and consistent mana production.

The deck focuses on using creatures with the En-Kor ability to protect Nadu, Winged Wisdom and combo off by drawing cards and generating mana with Gaea's Cradle. It aims to ramp up quickly using mana acceleration creatures like Birds of Paradise and Noble Hierarch, while utilizing cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to search for combo pieces. By efficiently building a board presence and generating mana, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a powerful Craterhoof Behemoth finish.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's entire library. By using cards like Doorkeeper Thrull and Phyrexian Dreadnought to put pressure on the opponent, while utilizing cards like Crucible of Worlds and Urza's Saga for card advantage and recurring threats, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and win the game through the combo. The inclusion of cards like Aether Vial and Mother of Runes provide additional flexibility and protection for key pieces of the combo.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful graveyard manipulation spells like Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring back powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier for explosive plays. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to control the game and protect its combo pieces. With a mix of card draw, removal, and mana denial through Wasteland, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo and overwhelm the opponent with huge threats, making it a force to be reckoned with in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

This combo-reanimator deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty, then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a huge advantage. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and counter opposing threats. With efficient card draw and mana acceleration, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures early in the game and secure a quick victory.
